from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from pyspark.sql.types import *

source_container = "retail-data"
entities = ["customers", "sales", "sales_orders"]
target_container = "bronze"

for entity in entities:

    print(f"Data processing started for entity: {entity}")

    df = spark.read.format("csv") \
        .option("header", "true") \
        .option("inferSchema", "true") \
        .load(f"abfss://{source_container}@ecomedevstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/{entity}/*")

    print(f"Read completed for {entity} in {source_container} container.")

    bronze_df = df \
        .withColumn("file_path", input_file_name()) \
        .withColumn("last_updated_ts", current_timestamp())

    print(f"Metadata columns added successfully. Now writing {entity}.")

    bronze_df.write \
        .format("delta")\
        .option("overwriteSchema", "true")\
        .mode("overwrite")\
        .save(f"abfss://{target_container}@ecomedevstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/{entity}/")

    print(f"Write completed for {entity} in {target_container} container.")
